gen-gf-grandstander-gf-inter-tight: Loud, constant-width strokes with open shapes: that's Grandstander. Inter Tight settles underneath with short ascenders and pulled-in curve tails, a modern sans-serif that lets the shouting heading feel friendly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kedebideri: Bold strokes, no swelling at the joins: that's Grandstander. Kedebideri backs it up with a skyward x-height, rounded letters that stay open, so heading and text feel like one cheerful voice at two volumes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-krub: Weighty curves that match their stems: that's Grandstander. Krub is where the pair gets its edge: a sans-serif with a pronounced x-height and curves that stop short of closing the loop.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend: Grandstander grabs attention with constant-width strokes and a grin. Lexend does the opposite job, letting oversized lowercase and open-jawed curves carry the actual reading while the heading just waves hello.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-matangi: Rounded, bold, a bit theatrical: Grandstander. Matangi, with its twine-like strokes and hefty lowercase, would feel heavy blown up large, and a small Grandstander heading loses its swagger.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spreads out, with generous gaps between letters. Over a full paragraph its sizable lowercase and swell-free curves feel easygoing, which leaves Grandstander free to be the loud one up top.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-headline: Playful, sturdy lines with open shapes: Grandstander. Give the heading plenty more size than Mozilla Headline, whose big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminal already speak up in this sans.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Grandstander is all stems, with no hairlines to thin it out. Noto Sans Avestan gives that weight somewhere to land, with open-tipped curves and a pronounced x-height in a modern sans.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi holds its mean line high, with open-ended curves on every letter. And across a full paragraph that sans-serif feels light, while Grandstander handles the shouting in uninterrupted strokes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-carian: Grandstander looks cut from laser sheet, every stroke one width. Give Noto Sans Carian, a sans-serif with scissor-open terminals, a smaller size than the heading, so its tiny ascender gaps stay crisp.
